Everything else unchanged: all five white outline pills, labels「状態」「担当者」「期日」「期間」「案件」, leading radial/people/relation icons, every down chevron, spacing, regular Meiryo text, plus and「条件を追加」, pure-white canvas. Do not add or restyle any element. Mock substitutions have no authority.
